# CheckYourRepresentative.com

> Non-partisan voter education. A free public record of how each member of the U.S. Congress votes, who funds their campaign, and what the people they represent think about the bills in front of Congress. Every figure comes from a named public source: Congress.gov, the Clerk of the House, Senate.gov, and the Federal Election Commission.

Published by We The People Inc. Contact: info@checkyourrepresentative.com

## Members of Congress

- [All members of Congress](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/congress): every sitting senator, representative, and delegate, by state and A to Z
- State delegations: https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/congress/{state-name}, for example [Colorado](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/congress/colorado)
- Member pages: https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/rep/{name}-{bioguide-id}. Each has roll call attendance for the current session, FEC campaign totals by cycle, donor breakdowns by gift size and state, committee assignments, recently sponsored bills, and contact details

## Bills

- [Bills in Congress, in plain English](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/bills): bills in the 119th Congress with plain-language breakdowns
- Bill pages: https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/bill/{type}-{number}-{congress}, for example https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/bill/hr-1-119. Status comes from Congress.gov and refreshes daily. The plain-language breakdowns are AI-written reading aids and are labeled as such

## The interactive tool

- [Vote on bills](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/vote): record a position on active bills
- [Accountability Matrix](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/accountability): district positions next to the representative's recorded votes
- [Roll calls](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/roll-calls): every recorded vote with every name attached
- [Follow the Money](https://www.checkyourrepresentative.com/follow-the-money): campaign money, donors, NGO funding, Social Security, Medicaid, and SNAP by county
